body: Additional bounded Document-owned source task coordinated with your active typed-save task3b2a6fa3. A AppModel recovery cannot release its saved-pixel reservation when DocumentWorkspace.editInLayers merely enqueues load. Add a small explicit exactly-once completion/settlement API to editInLayers/load, in a SEPARATE commit from save settlement. Prefer async result-bearing entry point or callback with documented outcome; retain captured engine/operation through backend openDocumentFromImage completion, error or drain, including workspace disappearing. All early rejects/stub path/failure paths settle; callback occurs only after source capture work completes, never at Task dispatch. Existing void callers may use wrapper. No polling of opening string, no main merge, no AppModel edits. Include tiny deterministic source tests for delayed completion, failure, early rejection and missing consumer/workspace where feasible, all UNRUN on B. Root resource agent will adapt A barrier once exact API available. This is a prerequisite for existing authorized Layers handoff, not authorization for global Quit/draft adapters. Prior B workload hold/paused heartbeat unchanged; perform in same existing writer without duplicate worker. Please prioritize the small API checkpoint enough to unblock A source integration; publish exact signature and commits.
